description: Look up real estate property data by street address or account number. Returns assessed value, market value, land value, improvement value, year built, square footage, lot size, acreage, exemptions (homestead, over 65, disabled veteran), and legal description. Use this for questions like "how much is this property worth?", "what's the tax value of this address?", "what are the property details?", or any real estate lookup. Owner names, heirs, deed opinions, and title conclusions are not returned. Coverage note: currently demo dataset for Montgomery County, TX (sample properties only). Broader live county coverage is not enabled by default and must be confirmed before purchase. Email support@livedatalink.ai to discuss a source-verified coverage requirement.

query.description: Street address or appraisal district account number

name: property_lookup
